jobs.title: Principal Strategic Development Manager, Creative Professionals
jobs.description:
Our Company

Changing the world via digital experiences is what Adobe's all about. We give everyone, from emerging artists to global brands, everything they need to build and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We're passionate about empowering people to create beautiful and powerful images, videos, documents and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen.

We're on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next breakthrough could be yours.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced, talented and motivated Strategic Development Manager to join our Creativity and Productivity Enterprise Customer Strategy and Success team. This role is perfect for individuals who are passionate about emerging solutions involving creative design, content production, and Artificial Intelligence. As a post-sales product specialist, you will help drive customer success and growth of our AI consumption business within our largest Enterprise creative agencies and professional services organizations. You will own driving adoption of Creative Cloud's generative AI capabilities, while also engaging with customers on Firefly Boards, Firefly APIs, Custom Models, Creative Foundations & Foundry opportunities. You will be responsible for managing the technical aspects of product enablement and adoption across specific customers, working closely with the assigned Customer Success Manager. You will play a pivotal role in helping our customers understand and leverage Adobe's enterprise software solutions, particularly within the Advertising and Professional Services industries, with a focus on creative workflow transformation and AI-driven consumption growth. A consultative approach, being comfortable engaging in strategic planning, solution development, technical business enablement, and process management, presenting and demoing to customer groups of all sizes, all while driving adoption of our emerging solutions will be the key to your success in this role.

Key Responsibilities

Drive growth of GenAI adoption within Creative Cloud, including GenAI MAU, credit consumption, and net new revenue, across a portfolio of strategic creative agencies and professional services organizations.
Lead enterprise demos, pilots, and proofs of concept for high-value use cases utilizing Firefly, AI Assistant, Custom Models, Video Production, Firefly Boards, and 3P integrations.
Engage customers on Firefly Enterprise API and Custom Model opportunities, including asset creation at scale, edit production assets, and localization/translation use cases.
Support customer engagement on Creative Foundations & Foundry, including world creation, review & approval workflows, and WIP asset storage in Frame.
Partner with Customer Success Managers, Sales, and Product teams to develop customized end-to-end enterprise solutions for your customers.
Engage executive and technical stakeholders to present strategic roadmaps, ROI, and adoption strategies tied to consumption and usage goals.
Drive customer advocacy activities, including live events, webinars, and Adobe Days.
Capture customer insights to feed back to and influence product and go-to-market strategy.

Minimum Requirements

Creative Expertise: Extensive design experience including mastery of Creative Cloud solutions, including Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Firefly, and/or other API solutions as a bonus.
Customer-Facing Experience: 7-10 years of experience in a customer-facing role such as Solutions Consultant, Sales Engineer, or Technical Sales, and/or in a Product Management / Product Evangelism role.
Technical Competence: Validated experience working in enterprise software and ability to grasp, adopt and teach new solutions quickly.
Presentation Skills: Strong ability to deliver engaging and persuasive software demonstrations both in-person and virtually, to audiences of all titles and sizes. Compelling on-camera presence for virtual engagement with customers.
AI Fluency: Foundational understanding of how artificial intelligence works, including its historical evolution and where the technology is headed, with the ability to translate that knowledge into credible customer conversations.
Consultative Approach: Ability to employ an advisory approach to comprehend business gaps and propose appropriate solutions.
Interpersonal Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of conveying intricate technical concepts clearly and concisely.
Travel Availability: Travel as required for the role, potentially making frequent trips. 10% - 30% travel.
Self-Starter: Ability to work independently, lead commitments, and deliver on deadlines successfully.

Desired Skills And Qualifications

Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of roles and inner-workings of creative agencies and/or in-house creative teams, through use of emerging technologies.

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.

Let’s Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.

Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com.

jobs.title: Principal Program Manager, Whole Foods Market Central Kitchen Strategy, Whole Foods Market Culinary Merchandising
jobs.description:
Description

Whole Foods Market is seeking a Principal Program Manager to help shape the future of how we produce freshly prepared food in centralized commissary kitchens. This is a strategic, senior role for someone who thrives in ambiguity and can define strategy where little exists today. Working across Amazon VP organizations and with senior leadership at WFM and Amazon, you will lead a significant, complex initiative from concept through execution, building the business case, aligning stakeholders, and standing up the mechanisms needed to deliver. The ideal candidate pairs deep strategic program management experience with a strong understanding of food service, kitchen production, supply chain, food safety, and multi-unit retail operations, and can influence and align senior leaders across culinary merchandising, supply chain, operations, finance, and technology.

Key job responsibilities

Own the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for a significant, complex initiative, driving clarity where the business problem and strategy are not yet fully defined.
Build out business cases and financial plans, framing capital, operational, and strategic tradeoffs for senior leaders and grounding recommendations in data.
Partner across merchandising, supply chain, operations, quality assurance and food safety, finance, technology, and other functional teams to align the organization on a coherent operating model and clear ownership.
Establish the planning, forecasting, and performance mechanisms needed to run the program and measure its success.
Design and launch pilots to validate our strategy, including clear learning plans, and create the stage gates that govern how and when the program scales.
Prepare and drive executive-ready reviews, business cases, and PR/FAQ and narrative documents, representing complex decisions and tradeoffs clearly to VPs and, when needed, SVPs.
Identify and mitigate program risks, building in the redundancy and contingency needed to protect continuity of service to stores and customers.
Actively develop the program management community through mentoring, promotion assessments, and best-practice sharing.
Travel Requirements: Approximately 30% travel to facilities, stores, and partner sites may be required.

About The Team

Our team is at the heart of transforming how customers experience fresh, prepared food at Whole Foods Market and Worldwide Grocery Stores. We set the category strategy and define production models that shape what lands on shelves and in shopping baskets across hundreds of stores nationwide. We work at the intersection of food, data, operations, and retail, partnering closely with supply chain, private brands, operations, e-commerce, finance, and technology to bring innovative, high-quality food programs to life. Our culture rewards curiosity, deep ownership, and creative problem-solving. If you are energized by building something new that directly shapes what customers eat every day, this is the team for you.

Basic Qualifications

7+ years of program or project management experience
7+ years of managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership experience
Bachelor's degree
Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
Experience owning program strategy and end to end delivery
Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
Experience in food production
Deep knowledge of food production and kitchen operations, supply chain and distribution, and the associated food safety and regulatory controls.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience delivering projects within scope, time, budget and quality
MBA
Experience working in a physical store
Experience designing or scaling fresh food production and distribution networks.
Working knowledge of food safety systems (HACCP), allergen and labeling requirements, and quality assurance at scale.

jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Location:
This role leads a global team and can be based in any major hub in AMER or EMEA.

Summary

Salesforce is seeking a dynamic and transformational Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) to lead the global Process Transformation (Regrello & Apromore) sales organization and serve as a key member of the AI Labs Leadership Team. This executive will own the growth strategy and commercial execution for the Process Transformation business, driving revenue growth, new customer acquisition, expansion, and scalable go-to-market motions globally. The CRO will play a critical role in shaping the future of the business, bringing together AI, data, and automation to redefine how customers optimize and transform their business processes.

The CRO will serve as a trusted advisor and strategic partner to senior leadership, helping define the business’s long-term growth strategy and strengthen Salesforce’s position for sustained market leadership. Success will require an unwavering customer focus, deep understanding of market dynamics, and the ability to translate strategy into disciplined execution across a complex, rapidly evolving organization.

The ideal candidate will bring enterprise-scale leadership, deep technical expertise in business process optimization, consultative nature, systematic builder, intellectual curiosity, commercial acumen, and exceptional organizational agility — with the ability to anticipate market shifts, align senior stakeholders, build and inspire high-performing teams, and accelerate growth in the era of the Agentic Enterprise.

Responsibilities

Own the revenue strategy for Process Transformation, driving durable, predictable growth across customer acquisition, expansion, retention, and disciplined execution.
Shape and execute the go-to-market strategy, leveraging targeted industry plays, optimized account coverage, strategic partnerships, and differentiated market motions to accelerate growth and customer adoption.
Lead the evolution of the sales motion in the era of the agentic enterprise, helping customers harness AI, data, and automation to transform business processes, customer engagement, and growth.
Serve as a trusted advisor to CEOs, CIOs, CTOs, Chief Data Officers, and other senior business leaders, positioning Salesforce’s Business Process Optimization portfolio as a strategic platform for enterprise transformation and measurable business outcomes.
Drive cross-functional alignment across Solution Engineering, Customer Success, Alliances & Channels, Industry GTM, and Enablement to deliver a unified, outcome-oriented customer experience and maximize revenue opportunities.
Own business performance and operating rigor, including forecasting, pipeline health, inspection, and performance management, providing clear, actionable insights to executive leadership.
Build and lead a high-performing organization, fostering a culture of accountability, customer obsession, and excellence while developing and retaining world-class talent.
Lead through organizational and market transformation, translating evolving business strategy into clear priorities, strong alignment, and decisive execution across the organization.
Serve as a strategic advisor to the Global CRO of AI Labs and the broader AI Labs Leadership Team, helping shape go-to-market priorities, investment decisions, organizational strategy, and critical initiatives that accelerate growth and scale the business.

Required Skills & Experience

15+ years of enterprise sales leadership experience, ideally with deep expertise in AI transformation, process mining and optimization, agentic SaaS, and/or emerging technology, with a proven track record of leading large-scale, global revenue organizations. 3rd- or 4th-line leadership experience required.
Proven ability to lead complex business transformation at scale, including cultural change, operating model evolution, organizational design, and capability building.
Strong general management, strategic planning, and operational leadership capabilities, with a disciplined, metrics-driven approach to execution and business performance.
Demonstrated ability to build trusted, long-term relationships with customers and C-level executives, translating those relationships into strategic partnerships and loyal, referenceable customers.
Exceptional cross-functional leadership in complex, matrixed organizations, with the ability to create alignment and drive outcomes across product, marketing, customer success, and regional field organizations without direct authority.
Executive presence and commercial acumen, with the credibility and influence to engage customers, partners, and internal stakeholders at the highest levels.
Outstanding executive communication skills, with the ability to articulate a compelling vision, simplify complexity, and inspire action across customers, field teams, and senior leadership forums.
Proven track record of recruiting, developing, and retaining exceptional sales leaders and go-to-market talent in highly competitive markets.
Relentless curiosity, agility, and adaptability, with the ability to prioritize effectively, navigate ambiguity, anticipate market shifts, and drive impact in a fast-moving environment.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

jobs.title: Director Product Management, Firefly Foundry
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Adobe is building Firefly Foundry, the platform for customizing any media model at any depth. It spans image, video, audio, and multi-modal models, Adobe’s own and third-party alike, so all of it happens in one place. From keeping a marketing team on-brand without touching a model, to training a model that generates a studio’s characters at production quality, Firefly Foundry lets enterprises work at whatever depth the problem calls for.

We are seeking a Director of Product Management to help lead the Firefly Foundry product organization. You will drive product strategy and roadmap for key areas of the platform and partner closely with engineering, AI research, design, forward-deployed teams, product marketing, and go-to-market.

This is a rare opportunity to help shape a net-new, AI-first enterprise platform at global scale — defining how the world’s brands, studios, and developers customize, govern, and deploy generative media models, and how Firefly Foundry becomes an essential surface for enterprise AI media.

What you’ll do

Drive product strategy and roadmap for core areas of Firefly Foundry, spanning the platform’s levels of customization — from shared brand context and prompt intelligence to self-serve model tuning and managed franchise-model training.
Identify high-impact opportunities, prioritize features, define success metrics, and own end-to-end delivery across a multi-model, multi-modal platform.
Build a platform that lets customers start at any level of customization and go deeper as the work changes, so nothing they build at one level gets stranded when they move to the next.
Translate complex model-customization capabilities — fine-tuning, evals, version history, prompt intelligence, and IP guardrails — into clear, self-serve product experiences for enterprise teams.
Partner closely with engineering, AI research, design, and forward-deployed creative technologists, engineers, and research scientists to cut the time from an idea to a model running in production.
Shape how Firefly Foundry is consumed: direct API access for customers’ own applications, pipelines, and agents, and native experiences inside Firefly Studio and the Creative Cloud apps teams already use.
Own the trust layer as a first-class product surface — safety classifiers, jailbreak and prompt-injection defenses, copyright indemnity, data isolation, and the compliance and certifications customers inherit.
Contribute to Foundry’s model-agnostic strategy and token economics, keeping the best available base model one contract-free switch away for every customer.
Share product vision inside and outside Adobe, gathering feedback from enterprise customers, partners, and internal teams to guide direction.
Mentor and support product managers on the team, setting a high bar for product craft, ownership, and execution.

What you’ll need to succeed

8 or more years of product management experience, including leading complex, multi-surface or platform products.
A strong understanding of generative media models (image, video, audio, and multi-modal) and model customization — fine-tuning, evaluation, and prompt engineering.
Experience building enterprise or developer platforms — APIs, SDKs, or infrastructure products serving both technical and business users.
Experience leading product in a matrixed organization and influencing across engineering, research, design, services, and go-to-market teams.
Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous, zero-to-one ideas and turn them into shipped, scaled products.
Strong product judgment and systems thinking, with comfort working at the intersection of ML, infrastructure, governance, and UX.
A builder’s mindset, comfortable with ambiguity, fast iteration, and learning through shipping.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

AWS Supply Chain Management (SCM) is building next-generation enterprise supply chain products from the ground up. Come be part of the team enabling Amazon AWS to rapidly grow and continue as the pioneer and widely recognized leader in Cloud Computing — and have immediate impact on thousands of developers and businesses around the world. We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for our Fulfillment Planning systems — the operational planning engine that decides what to manufacture, when to build it, and where to land it across our global infrastructure.

Why this role matters: AWS is massively scaling its infrastructure to meet unprecedented demand. We are redefining how we plan and execute fulfillment — driving hands-off-the-wheel automation and optimization to replace the manually intensive, computationally complex, and error-prone processes of today. You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

jobs.description:
Description

Amazon's devices are moving from responding to what customers say to perceiving the world around them. Echo, Fire TV, Ring, and the next generation of ambient devices increasingly see, hear, and remember so they can be genuinely helpful. That capability only earns a place in the home if customers trust how it handles what it perceives.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to own the product vision and roadmap for Ambient Trust. You will define how always-on perceiving devices respect the physical space and the people in it, and you will turn that into shipped customer experiences, from today's early real-time visual features to a broad ambient transparency and control surface across the device fleet. You will work across product, engineering, science, design, hardware, legal, and privacy to make trust a reason customers choose our devices.

Key job responsibilities

Own the multi-year product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Ambient Trust across perceiving surfaces (including voice, vision, and ambient sensing).
Define the customer experience for ambient transparency and control
Advance real-time visual understanding experiences from early release toward dependable activation, accuracy, broader device coverage, and proactive, opt-in capabilities.
Write the narratives and requirements that align leadership and partner teams, and represent Ambient Trust in cross-organization reviews with Product, Hardware, Engineering, Legal, Responsible AI, and Privacy.
Define the metrics that prove ambient experiences are both trusted and useful, and use them to prioritize.

No two days look the same in this role. You will move between setting long-term product direction and making the concrete calls that keep experiences moving, partnering closely with engineering, science, design, and other teams to turn a hard trust problem into something customers actually feel. You will spend time listening to customers and translating what you learn into priorities, aligning leaders and partner teams behind a clear plan, and making the judgment calls that balance capability, usefulness, and trust. The common thread is that you are the person making sure that as our devices become more capable, customers feel more in control, not less.

Who We Are:

Trust CX Innovations is a strategic innovation team within Amazon Devices & Services that focuses on advancing AI technology while prioritizing customer trust and experience. Our team operates at the intersection of artificial intelligence, privacy engineering, and customer-centric design.

To pioneer trustworthy AI innovations that delight customers while setting new standards for privacy and responsible technology development. We aim to transform how Amazon builds AI products by creating solutions that balance innovation with customer trust.

Identify and drive new-to-world opportunities that expand Amazon Connect's addressable market beyond the traditional contact center (e.g., IT service management, healthcare, recruiting)

Make high-judgment trade-off decisions across competing priorities, customer commitments, and technical investments — operating as the named product decision-maker for your domain

Represent the product externally with strategic enterprise customers (e.g., JPMC, Intuit, Telstra, CalSAWS), translating customer needs into product strategy and unblocking multi-million dollar migrations

Mentor and develop Senior PMTs on the team, raising the product management bar across the organization

Influence without authority across engineering, science, design, GTM, and finance teams to drive alignment on complex, ambiguous, multi-team initiatives

You will own the connection between platform capabilities and end-customer experience improvements, defining how infrastructure investments enabling Product teams to drive measurable gains in personalization quality, content discovery, and customer engagement metrics.

At Amazon, data is critical to everything we do, from understanding product inventories across our global fulfillment centers to predicting what products to recommend to customers. Data ceaselessly informs our flywheel, helping us to understand customer needs, onboard new sellers and selection, and identify opportunities for cost savings. Business Data Technologies (BDT) provides trustworthy, intuitive, and cost-efficient solutions for Amazonians to secure, store, analyze, and transform this data at unparalleled scale. BDT owns, develops, and operates Andes, one of the largest data lakes in the world, storing 3+ exabytes of data, read/written to by 100k+ data pipelines, with >60k monthly active users. To do this, we need extraordinary individuals to build the next generation of data analytics, machine learning, and AI solutions for thousands of scientists, engineers, and analysts who rely upon us to get their jobs done.

The BDT-AI4ME organization works bring AI-centric methodologies and automations to Amazon organizations needing to connect their business teams and objectives with their data teams and architectures. The BDT-AI4ME organization seeks to lower the cognitive load needed to connect business to data through best of class agents and AI-ready metadata to allow anyone to access data to gain insights.

BDT Principal Product Managers - Tech (PMT) provide the three-year product visions and strategies for their ~50 person organizations, while also providing clear, iterative roadmaps to get there. They deliver results in collaboration with Engineering teams and Principal Engineers to create clean architectures that support coherent and intuitive user experiences. As a Principal Product Manager in the BDT-AI4ME organization, you understand ways that enterprises apply AI to solve business and technical problems. You understand the ways that Amazon’s business teams work with their data teams, and you seek to reduce friction and error-proneness of those interactions by enhancing business processes and automations using AI.

Key job responsibilities

You focus on the data needs of business users and their user journeys from question to insight. You formulate a strategy for transforming the ways Amazon extracts value from its data through iterative improvements involving AI enablement, process optimization, role guidelines, and org design.

You work backwards from user needs, and leverage data such as service telemetry, user feedback, and industry trends to author PR/FAQs, 3-year strategies, roadmaps, launch announcements, and user documentation. As part of a broader team, you collaborate with other product managers to ensure that work in your space works coherently with current and upcoming features being launched by other BDT teams, give feedback on narratives, contribute to strategy (e.g., OP1 planning), set goals, discuss weekly business metrics, and more.

Data drives your “flywheel”. You analyze data to glean insights that drive experimentation. You take what’s proven and partner with Amazon organizations to apply and scale it. You define, implement, and monitor metrics that track your progress.

You partner with Amazon’s business orgs to test hypotheses and deploy AI-based solutions to reduce friction and risk of errors in the ways that businesses use data.

You partner with Amazon’s PXT organization to evolve and optimize roles guidelines and org design best practices to align with the way businesses are evolving their practices around getting insights from their data.

You understand and work to improve the interfaces (MCPs, APIs) that technology teams of Amazon’s business orgs use to connect their bespoke AI solutions to the Andes data lake.

Launching a capability is only the start. Post launch, you are responsible for increasing usage, iterating on user feedback, and user education. You partner with engineering, human resources, legal, documentation, solution architecture, privacy, finance, and more to optimize usage of the Andes data lake for AI-based methodologies.

As an owner, you hold yourself and partners accountable for the highest quality user outcomes.

You provide clarity where there is ambiguity.

Basic Qualifications

7+ years of end to end product delivery experience
10+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
Experience delivering large-scale SaaS, PaaS or LaaS products where you are responsible for the full product lifecycle, from concept through GTM (go to market)
Experience making product decisions using judgment and data, including collaborating with users and internal partners to solicit diverse perspectives
Experience successfully improving processes for product management and for collaboration with partner teams
Experience defining and executing go-to-market strategies
Experience influencing executive leadership through verbal and written communication
Experience negotiating, influencing, planning, and executing across teams
Bachelor's degree, or higher

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of current trends and approaches to applying AI to business needs
Technical depth in databases, data lakes, storage, and distributed systems, including architectural and operational aspects
Experience working with and influencing senior level stakeholders

Amazon Autos is building the end-to-end vehicle buying experience on Amazon. We launched in the consumer-experience era; we are now redesigning for the AI era, and every surface (shopping, advertising, dealer intelligence, attribution, in-store) has to be rethought for what AI now makes possible. jobs.description:
Description

Amazon is seeking a Senior Product Manager to drive the product strategy and execution for AWIPL — Amazon's only 1P retail entity for B2B in India. AWIPL exists to solve a fundamentally hard problem: the tools and playbooks that power Amazon's B2C businesses were never designed for the B2B operating model.

This is a zero-to-one product role. You will not inherit a mature product with an established tech stack. You will define what needs to be built, work with stakeholders for prioritization across 20+ cross-functional partner teams, write the BRDs and PRFAQs that make the business case, and own delivery end-to-end across multiple concurrent initiatives

AWIPL serves two distinct B2B customer segments: SSR customers (small sole proprietors and independent retailers) and CPS customers (large enterprises like Infosys procuring at scale). Each segment has different selection, pricing, fulfillment, and credit requirements, and neither is adequately served by existing Amazon B2C tooling. You will close that gap at the foundational level.

The role carries broad scope and senior leadership visibility. You will present weekly to leadership team, align stakeholders across organizations, and operate in an environment where every product decision has a direct, measurable impact.

Key job responsibilities

Own the AWIPL product roadmap acros, spanning tools parity and scalable growth capabilities
Write PRFAQs, BRDs, and technical intake documents to secure engineering capacity from partner teams including WW AB Tech, SCOT, Recommerce, FC Ops, Tax Engine, and FinOps.
Drive delivery of in-flight initiatives:
Define and execute the 3YF product vision.
Leverage AI and automation to shift AWIPL from reactive firefighting to predictive decision-making: WBR diagnostic platforms, causal knowledge graphs, predictive OOS models, and CPS deal workflow automation eliminating 100+ hours/month of manual coordination.
Communicate strategy, progress, and blockers to senior leaders weekly and align partner team leadership to prioritize AWIPL's roadmap asks above competing demands.

About The Team

AWIPL is Amazon India's B2B retail entity, operating at the intersection of 1P retail and enterprise B2B. We are building Amazon Business India's supply chain from the ground up — solving problems that have no off-the-shelf answers, no existing playbooks, and no direct WW analogues. Our customers are Indian enterprises and retailers. Our opportunity is a $1.2T Indian retail market with only 7% e-commerce penetration and 15MM offline retailers underserved by traditional distribution.

Basic Qualifications

6+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience

jobs.description:
Description

AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Do you want to define the scientific direction for how a global contact-center network forecasts demand, schedules its workforce, and optimizes operations in real time? The Eliza team within Amazon Connect (FCS) is looking for a Principal Research Scientist with a deep operations research specialization to set the research agenda in operations science — combinatorial optimization, queueing theory, stochastic modeling, and forecasting — and to translate that research into production systems that serve millions of customer interactions.

As a Principal Research Scientist you will be the senior technical voice for operations research across the org. You will identify the highest-leverage scientific problems, architect novel solutions, and drive them from research through production deployment. You will not sit apart from the work - you will remain deeply hands-on with data, models, and systems while raising the scientific bar for scientists and engineers around you. This is an individual-contributor Principal role: your influence comes from technical depth, invention, and the ability to move business and engineering roadmaps through scientific rigor.

You will operate at the intersection of demand forecasting, workforce scheduling, and network optimization - applying combinatorial optimization to large-scale scheduling and resource-allocation problems and queueing theory to model contact-center dynamics under uncertainty, non-stationarity, and competing operational constraints at Internet scale - turning that reasoning into systems that continuously sense, predict, and optimize.

Key job responsibilities

Set the multi-year research direction for operations research across contact-center demand prediction, workforce scheduling, and network optimization.
Design and deliver novel algorithms in combinatorial optimization (large-scale scheduling, resource allocation, integer/constraint programming) and queueing theory (contact-center modeling, staffing under stochastic arrivals), alongside stochastic modeling and time-series forecasting, that advance the state of the art while solving real operational problems.
Own end-to-end scientific solutions — from problem formulation and prototyping to production deployment — ensuring robustness, explainability, and seamless integration with existing systems.
Design rigorous experiments and evaluation methodology to validate hypotheses and quantify business impact; establish scientific-excellence mechanisms (metrics, benchmarks, peer review) that the broader science team adopts.
Partner with engineering, product, and operations teams to define data and logging requirements, get them prioritized on roadmaps, and translate scientific capabilities into measurable business outcomes.
Influence senior leadership through written papers and deep-dives, framing complex algorithmic trade-offs in clear business terms.
Mentor and raise the bar for applied and research scientists across the org while maintaining significant hands-on technical contribution.
Represent the team's science externally where appropriate (publications, patents, top-tier venues such as INFORMS, NeurIPS, ICML).

A day in the life

Your day blends hands-on science with technical leadership. You might spend the morning deep in data and models — prototyping a new combinatorial-optimization formulation for workforce scheduling or a queueing model for staffing under stochastic arrivals against production infrastructure — and the afternoon guiding fellow scientists through a hard optimization or stochastic-modeling problem, reviewing an experiment design, or aligning engineering partners on the data architecture needed to unlock the next capability. You'll drive technical discussions with the team and key stakeholders and periodically write and present papers that shape the business and engineering roadmap.

We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Product Manager, Quick Sight - Structured Data Analytics
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Quick is a decision intelligence service for the AI era. Today, thousands of enterprises and millions of users rely on Quick to connect their data, generate insights, and turn decisions into action — whether through interactive dashboards, embedded analytics woven into the products their customers use, natural language experiences that let any knowledge worker ask a question and get an answer they can act on immediately or fully managed tools that they can build and deploy for their stakeholders. 1000s of ISVs and SaaS companies have already built Quick into the fabric of their applications, powering experiences for millions of end users who benefit from intelligent, data-driven products. That is the kind of reach we operate at — and we are just getting started.

We are now at an inflection point. The convergence of structured data analytics, natural language interfaces, and agentic AI is rewriting the rules of what a decision intelligence service can do — not just for analysts, but for every knowledge worker in an enterprise. Quick sits at the center of this shift. We're building the service that lets an enterprise analyst build a governed dashboard in minutes, an ISV embed AI-powered analytics into their product with a few API calls, and a business leader ask a question in plain English and receive an insight they can turn into action before the day is over. The same service. The same governed data. One experience that scales from a single user to an entire organization — unlocking productivity, surfacing new opportunities, and accelerating businesses that are powered by data.

Role

We are hiring a product leader for structured data analytics product team to own critical parts of this journey. This role spans some of the most consequential product areas in cloud analytics and decision intelligence today:

The data and intelligence foundation — how enterprises bring structured and unstructured data together under a unified semantic and governance layer that powers both BI reporting and AI-driven insights that turn into action.

Embedding and ISV enablement — how thousands of companies build differentiated, analytics-rich products on top of Quick's capabilities, and how we make that experience so seamless it becomes the default choice for every builder.

Business model and growth strategy — how we design packaging, pricing, and adoption pathways that make it effortless for customers to start, experiment, and scale with us — turning first deployments into enterprise-wide commitments.

What unites these roles is a shared profile: a deeply technical product leader who is equal parts strategist and practitioner. Someone who can see the three-year arc of a market and then roll up their sleeves to ship the next release. Someone who works backward from the customer's deployment — not from a requirements document — and who measures their own success by whether the customer succeeded. Someone who sees a nascent, fast-growing business not as a risk but as a canvas.

Quick is a business that is growing, evolving, and actively being shaped by the people on this team. You will have a direct and visible thumbprint on a service that is becoming the decision intelligence layer for enterprises and AI-powered products alike. The decisions you make — about what we build, how we package it, who we build it for, and how we bring it to market — will define how thousands of organizations and millions of knowledge workers experience data, make decisions, and take action in the age of AI.

If you are a builder who gets energy from ambiguity, who thinks in systems but ships in increments, and who wants to be at the frontier of where decision intelligence meets artificial intelligence — we want to talk to you.

Key job responsibilities

Drive product delivery in deep partnership with engineering, applied science, and design. Drive product specifications, make crisp tradeoff decisions, and ensure high bar on the quality and user experience
Be hands-on with the technology. Whether that means understanding how a semantic model resolves a natural language query, how an embedded analytics SDK integrates into a partner's React app, or how a pricing SKU flows through AWS billing — you operate at the level of detail where real product decisions are made.
Own broad customer journeys from first contact through enterprise-wide adoption for critical engagement. Partner with GTM and Sales teams to design onboarding pathways, migration playbooks, and growth motions that reduce friction, accelerate time-to-value, and turn successful deployments into organization-wide productivity gains.
Engage directly with enterprise customers, ISV partners, and AWS field teams. Turn what you hear into product conviction — not just feature requests, but insight into where the market is moving and what customers will need before they know to ask for it.
Directly contribute to business outcomes — adoption, revenue, competitive win rates, customer retention. Use data relentlessly to prioritize, to make the case for investment, and to communicate progress to senior leadership.

A day in the life

You might start your morning reviewing customer adoption metrics and operational dashboards, then shift into a working session with engineering and design partners to refine an upcoming feature launch. After lunch, you could be authoring a technical white paper or preparing a strategic narrative for leadership review. Later, you may lead a session with C-suite Data and AI executives on how their enterprise data can be turned into business outcomes using AWS analytics. Throughout it all, you bring clarity to tough trade-offs and ensure every stakeholder has the context they need.

About The Team

Our team is focused on building and evolving externally facing services that empower businesses of all sizes to succeed. We operate with a strong sense of ownership and collaborate closely with science, research, engineering, design, marketing, and sales partners to deliver AI powered products that customers love and see how they can accelerate business value. We value decisiveness, curiosity, creative problem-solving, and a commitment to raising the bar for one another while being deeply technical and obsess about working backwards from customer problems.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager Technical (PMT-ES), Amazon S3
jobs.description:
Description

Come build the future of high performance storage with Amazon S3 Express, the storage class purpose built to co-locate storage with compute and deliver consistent single digit millisecond data access. Launched at re:Invent 2023, it is designed for the most demanding, performance sensitive workloads, and we are still in the earliest innings. As AI training, inference, and agentic workloads reshape what applications demand from storage, this is where the hardest problems get solved.

As a Principal PMT, you will own product strategy for a service operating at the frontier of performance. The AI space is moving fast, the requirements are ambiguous, and the technical challenges are hard. Defining what the product becomes, from first principles, is the core of this role. You will drive an agentic storage strategy that confronts the inference memory wall and the explosion of context windows, shifting workloads away from compute heavy architectures and toward layered caching fabrics. You will shape a portfolio of storage products built for AI model training and inference, anchoring general purpose solutions around ultra low latency and POSIX compliant workloads while extending the high bandwidth object storage that S3 Express delivers. You will also focus on accelerator utilization across GPU, Trainium, and Inferentia deployments, provisioning high performance zonal storage with the goal of a full accelerator attach rate.

You will spend your time in product definition, navigating ambiguity, solving deep technical problems, and building the storage foundation that future workloads will depend on. You will thrive here if you love technology, can reason about complex distributed systems, and enjoy working shoulder to shoulder with engineering teams. You bring a strong ownership bias, a persistent drive to make things better, and you are comfortable facilitating executive reviews, diving deep into data, and expressing ideas clearly through writing.

A defining part of this role is who you work with. You will partner with industry leaders across the AI space and teams throughout AWS to solve horizontal high performance computing problems.

(Principal PMT / Principal PMT-ES)

In this role you will

Develop crisp business requirements and user stories through direct contact with customers and partners at the leading edge of AI and high performance computing
Define product strategy and roadmap, translating ambiguous, fast moving requirements into a clear path forward
Solve the storage challenges of AI training and inference, from the inference memory wall to accelerator utilization, by shaping layered caching and high performance zonal storage
Collaborate with product managers, software development managers, and engineers to define, build, and roll out features
Bring services and features to market, including beta programs, product marketing, and industry analyst engagement
Present solutions and the roadmap to customers at conferences and executive briefings

jobs.description:
Description

Amazon's Devices & Services (D&S) organization builds and markets consumer products used by hundreds of millions of customers worldwide—including Ring, Blink, Alexa, Kindle, Fire TV, and more. Within D&S, the Demand Science & Optimization (DSO) organization is responsible for the science, data, and products that drive pricing, marketing measurement, demand forecasting, and spend optimization across 50+ product lines in 10+ countries.

Today, the vast majority of D&S's marketing and pricing allocation decisions rely on proxy assumptions rather than direct experimental evidence. We are building the Experimentation & Economic Value Platform to change that: a centralized system that connects experimentation across pricing, marketing, and merchandising into causal science and forecasting models, so every investment decision is backed by evidence rather than assumption.

We are seeking a Principal Product Manager-Tech to own this product end-to-end. You will define the conceptual architecture for a suite of interconnected services—experimentation engines spanning pricing, marketing, and economic value measurement, along with a parameter store, experiment registry, and coordination layer—and partner closely with engineering to build them. A critical part of the role is connecting science outcomes to production systems: ensuring that experiment results, model parameters, and causal estimates flow reliably into the downstream decision products that consume them. You will own the product and experimentation roadmap, define success metrics on usage, engagement, and efficiency, build a streamlined intake process, and drive integration with downstream science and business-facing products. This is a high-visibility, high-autonomy role where you will shape how Amazon's largest consumer hardware business makes data-driven decisions.

Key job responsibilities

Define the Conceptual Architecture

Define and deliver the conceptual architecture for the platform's experimentation engines (pricing, marketing, and economic value measurement), parameter store, experiment registry, coordination layer, and results store
Define integration points with downstream science models (e.g., incrementality modeling, demand forecasting) and business-facing products (e.g., spend optimization, scenario planning, and emerging optimization products)
Partner closely with engineering leadership to translate the conceptual architecture into technical designs, and sequence the development roadmap

Own the Product Vision, Roadmap & Prioritization

Define and drive the product vision, tenets, and multi-year roadmap for the Experimentation & Economic Value Platform
Own the experimentation intake process, roadmap, and prioritization across pricing, marketing, and economic value workstreams; prioritize science and engineering bandwidth in partnership with DSO Product and Engineering managers
Define, prioritize, and track product success metrics: platform adoption, usage, engagement, experiment velocity, model calibration improvement, and iROAS gains

Build a Scalable, AI-Augmented Experimentation Product

Define how AI agents and automated workflows accelerate experimentation design, execution, monitoring, and insights across the full experimentation lifecycle
Own and deliver experimentation platforms for joint marketing and pricing experiments
Implement monitoring systems in partnership with data science and software development—covering data quality, statistical significance, and optimization recommendations—across marketing experimentation and economic value refresh processes

Drive Rigorous Experiment Design & Execution

Translate user stories and business questions into statistically rigorous randomized controlled trials (RCTs) at the geo and user level
Own experiment prioritization, design quality, and execution standards globally—ensuring consistency across macro experiments (geo-level strategic allocation questions) and micro experiments (platform-native A/B tests optimizing creative, audience, and bid strategies)
Partner with economists and data scientists to define RCT validity criteria, create reusable design templates, develop power calculation guidelines, and establish quality bars to ensure direct usability by the business

Lead Stakeholder Engagement & Operational Excellence

Establish regular business reviews with senior leadership (VP+) to communicate platform progress, experiment impact, and investment priorities
Build a streamlined, trackable intake process that replaces ad-hoc coordination with structured experiment requests, transparent prioritization, and automated scheduling

Experience working directly with engineering teams

Amazon Aurora is a MySQL and PostgreSQL-compatible, relational database engine that combines the speed and availability of high-end commercial databases with the simplicity and cost-effectiveness of open source databases. Work on a disruptive product that’s still in its very early stages
Solve challenging problems that will revolutionize database computing in the cloud

Have direct impact on hundreds and thousands of users of AWS database services

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Customer Service (Amazon CS) organization is seeking a Sr Product Manager to own the end-to-end Service Design experience for Alexa products and services.

This role owns conceptualizing, building, and enhancing customer service experiences that impact millions of Alexa customers, in a space of strategic importance where the problem, opportunity, and strategy may not yet be defined. You will work backwards from customer pain points to define product vision, write strategy documents (PRFAQs, narratives, roadmaps), and drive execution across product, engineering, design, and operations teams. You will define success through measurable outcomes, distinguishing between output metrics like defects eliminated and effort reduction, and outcome metrics like customer satisfaction, engagement, and quality of experience.

As the critical intersection point for customer needs, business goals, and technical possibilities, you will lead cross-organizational initiatives that drive value with increased product engagement, or lower cost to serve by increasing operational efficiencies. You will apply one-way and two-way door judgment to high-stakes decisions, challenge assumptions, and establish strategic frameworks adoptable by other teams. You will embrace emerging technology shifts and adopt industry trends to define the best-in-class service offering to secure customer loyalty. While driving multi-year investments that reshape the CS landscape, you'll instrument new success measures where necessary as you secure cross-functional commitment to build solutions to mitigate customer pain points.

This leader earns trust and influences without authority at the Director and VP levels across Product, Marketing, Engineering, Finance, Legal, PR and Operations teams by leveraging data and grounding recommendations based on business priorities or holistic organizational needs.

Key job responsibilities

Own the 3 to 5 year product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Alexa Customer Service, spanning Hardware, Digital Services and third-party integrations. Drive clarity where strategy is undefined, and create frameworks that enable organizational action.
Champion exceptional customer experiences grounded in utility, intuitiveness, and simplicity. Partner with design on mockups and prototypes, scrutinizing details while aligning with strategic goals. Ensure customer validation reflects diverse perspectives and drive strategic CX conversations across your area.
Demonstrate deep technical curiosity. Evaluate engineering proposals, ask the right questions, and ensure sound trade-offs. Understand key architecture decisions, the assumptions behind them, and whether those assumptions still hold. Bring performance, scale, and flexibility perspectives into engineering conversations early.
Identify and embrace technology shifts before they become obvious. Drive multi-year technology investments and evaluate complex technical proposals. Apply AI and agentic capabilities to accelerate development, improve decisions, and unlock innovation.
Influence without authority across CS and other VP organizations, building alignment across teams with different priorities. Present regularly to Directors and VPs, align on OP1/OP2/goals, and own executive engagement for critical issues. Amplify impact by developing others and actively recruiting PM talent.
Serve as the recognized CS Voice of the Customer in product design, ideation, and launch readiness, personally driving cross-functional VP level goals. Engage senior decision-makers to uncover non-obvious insights. Define CS requirements, hold launches to a high experience bar, and advocate for prioritization of solutions that address customer feedback drivers.

A day in the life

On any given day, you will drive strategic conversations with senior leaders, leveraging data to influence investments and priorities to enhance the Alexa device and digital product Customer Service experience - advocating for upstream defect elimination, empowering customers with self-service capabilities or optimizing our human-in-the-loop support offering. You serve as the connective tissue between CS service design, operations, product line stakeholders, and partner organizations, setting priorities and driving alignment across teams with different objectives.

You will present investment narratives in Director and VP level product reviews, fielding questions on customer impact, scalability, business sustainability, and competitive positioning. You will balance setting the 3 to 5 year vision with near-term execution: defining cross-org launch requirements, authoring OP1/OP2 narratives, building consensus on bold bets, and measuring impact across your portfolio.

You will drive multi-year technology investment decisions, evaluating how agentic capabilities could reshape the CS experience, forming views on ROI and market timing, and determining when to make bold bets versus invest in further validation. You will define investment areas within operational planning cycles, build cross-functional consensus on long-term strategic direction, and establish the metrics frameworks and measurement strategies that other teams adopt.

About The Team

D2SD (Digital and Devices Service Design) is part of the Customer Service Experience (CSX) team within Amazon CS, and owns the end-to-end customer service experience across Amazon's Digital and Device portfolio. We are the advocates for the CS experience for customers using our device and digital products, and relentlessly work to remove customer facing defects, improving quality and shaping how millions of customers use our products and get help. Our insights drive product improvements upstream, and our mechanisms set the standard for Customer Obsession within Amazon Customer Service.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Bachelor's degree or equivalent
Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of key customer experience metrics and methodology (e.g., NPS)
Experience owning technology products
Experience in Customer Service

jobs.description:
Description

AI is transforming every corner of Amazon — and with that transformation comes the responsibility to get it right. The Amazon Responsible AI (RAI) team is building the systems and programs that ensure Amazon's AI is fair, safe, transparent, and compliant with emerging global regulations. We are looking for a Sr. Product Manager - Technical who wants to define the product vision for AI governance at Amazon scale — building the tools and experiences that help thousands of builder teams develop AI responsibly without slowing down.

No one has solved AI governance at this scale before. Today, tracking thousands of AI systems against evolving regulatory frameworks, internal expectations, and voluntary commitments is a problem that's impossible to manage manually. You'll define the product that makes it possible — automating what would take an army of auditors, and giving builders the tools to do the right thing without slowing down. This is a greenfield opportunity on a small, senior team building from scratch alongside Amazon Scholars, Principal Applied Scientists, and policy experts. You'll own the product vision and shape the platform direction.

As a PMT on the Responsible AI team, you will define and drive the product strategy for our AI governance platform, working at the intersection of technology, policy, and science. You'll partner deeply with engineering teams building the platform, Applied Scientists developing AI-powered classification and assessment models, and policy experts interpreting regulatory requirements — turning ambiguity into a clear, prioritized roadmap that delivers customer value.

This role is for product leaders who thrive in ambiguity, are energized by the challenge of defining new product categories, and are motivated by the societal impact of ensuring AI systems are developed responsibly.

Key job responsibilities

Define the product vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for Amazon's AI governance platform — the system that provides portfolio-level visibility into AI compliance posture across the company
Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for responsible AI tooling: from discovery and customer research through requirements definition, development, launch, and adoption at scale
Translate complex regulatory requirements (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, emerging state/federal AI legislation) and internal responsible AI expectations into builder-friendly product experiences and self-service workflows
Drive product strategy for AI system discovery, risk classification, and compliance evidence collection — working backward from builder needs to reduce friction while meeting governance obligations

jobs.title: Principal Applied Scientist
jobs.description:
Overview

The MSAI Search Relevance team is at the forefront of delivering world-class search quality across Microsoft's ecosystem. We are the driving force behind the relevance of results in Copilot Search experiences and serve as the core retrieval layer in the RAG architecture powering Bizchat (CoPilot Chat). Our impact also extends to maintaining high search quality across traditional endpoints like Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint Search. Our team thrives at the intersection of innovation and applied machine learning.

We are looking for a Principal Applied Scientist
to help us deliver breakthrough applied machine learning and information retrieval solutions at enterprise scale. This role is a unique opportunity to apply state-of-the-art techniques-including dense retrieval, hybrid search, multilingual large language models (LLMs), RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and transformer-based re-ranking models and agentic search-to solve complex challenges in Copilot-driven enterprise search.

As a Principal Applied Scientist
, you'll be responsible for delivering mission-critical innovations that directly improve Copilot experiences such as:

Agentic Search in modern orchestrator architectures
Adapting advanced vector search algorithms (e.g., FAISS, ANN, ScaNN) for enterprise-scale semantic retrieval
Improving classic and neural keyword search quality through deep language understanding
Designing and training relevance models, including LLM fine-tuning and learning-to-rank (LTR) approaches
Building robust evaluation pipelines using offline metrics and online A/B experimentation
Driving cross-org collaboration with platform partners, other applied science teams, and product teams across time zones
Setting vision and directions for agentic search in CoPilot Chat inspired by state-of-the-art and data-driven analysis

This role requires a mix of technical depth, strategic execution, and people management to shape the next generation of AI-powered search experiences.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

Drive end-to-end applied science projects: From ideation and design to implementation, experimentation, and shipping, you will lead high-impact projects that directly improve Copilot Chat, Copilot Search, and BizChat experiences. This includes identifying search and relevance gaps, formulating innovative hypotheses, and delivering scalable solutions.
Inspire help to grow a high-performing applied science team: mentor, and empower a team of applied scientists-owning their technical direction, project execution, and career development. You will guide day-to-day work, ensure scientific and engineering rigor, and be accountable for the team's output and impact.
Innovate with scientific rigor: Invent and apply cutting-edge techniques in machine learning, natural language processing, and information retrieval to address real-world challenges at enterprise scale. You will design novel approaches for improving retrieval, ranking, query understanding, and semantic search in Copilot systems.
Document, share, and amplify learnings: Promote a culture of transparency and innovation by capturing experimental results, documenting methodology, and publishing internal learnings. You'll drive knowledge sharing that enables broader impact across the organization.
Translate business goals into scientific strategy: Partner closely with product and business stakeholders to align team efforts with high-priority objectives. You will translate ambiguous product requirements into clear, data-driven, and technically feasible directions.
Collaborate across organizations and time zones: Work cross-functionally with platform engineering teams, peer science orgs, and product managers to ensure alignment, resolve dependencies, and unblock progress. You'll be a key bridge between applied science innovation and product delivery.
Embody our Culture and Values.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field AND 6+ years related experience (e.g., statistics, predictive analytics, research)
OR Master's Degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field AND 4+ years related experience (e.g., statistics, predictive analytics, research)
OR Doctorate in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field AND 3+ years related experience (e.g., statistics, predictive analytics, research)
OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

Microsoft Cloud Background Check:
This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's Degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field AND 12+ years related experience (e.g., statistics, predictive analytics, research)
OR Doctorate in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field AND 10+ years related experience (e.g., statistics, predictive analytics, research)
OR equivalent experience.

5+ years experience in applied science projects from ideation to production-in high-scale environments such as search, recommendation, or conversational AI.
5+ years experience in data analysis at scale, including working with logs, telemetry, and large datasets to uncover behavioral patterns, build evaluation datasets, and derive insights.
6+ years experience creating publications (e.g., patents, libraries, peer-reviewed academic papers).
2+ years experience presenting at conferences or other events in the outside research/industry community as an invited speaker.
5+ years experience conducting research as part of a research program (in academic or industry settings).
5+ years experience developing and deploying live production systems, as part of a product team.
5+ years experience developing and deploying products or systems at multiple points in the product cycle from ideation to shipping.
Experience in search and ranking systems, semantic retrieval, and information retrieval at scale.
Applied experience with state-of-the-art sparse and dense retrieval and ranking techniques.
Experience with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures using LLMs such as OpenAI GPT, T5, or Llama.
Experience with Fine-tuning or prompt engineering of large-scale language models for query rewriting, summarization, and document reranking.
Familiarity with hybrid search strategies, learning-to-rank (LTR) frameworks, and evaluation methodologies for IR systems (offline metrics, A/B testing, relevance judgments).

Whole Foods Market is seeking a Principal Program Manager to help shape the future of how we produce freshly prepared food in centralized commissary kitchens. This is a strategic, senior role for someone who thrives in ambiguity and can define strategy where little exists today. Working across Amazon VP organizations and with senior leadership at WFM and Amazon, you will lead a significant, complex initiative from concept through execution, building the business case, aligning stakeholders, and standing up the mechanisms needed to deliver. The ideal candidate pairs deep strategic program management experience with a strong understanding of food service, kitchen production, supply chain, food safety, and multi-unit retail operations, and can influence and align senior leaders across culinary merchandising, supply chain, operations, finance, and technology.

Key job responsibilities

Own the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for a significant, complex initiative, driving clarity where the business problem and strategy are not yet fully defined.
Build out business cases and financial plans, framing capital, operational, and strategic tradeoffs for senior leaders and grounding recommendations in data.
Partner across merchandising, supply chain, operations, quality assurance and food safety, finance, technology, and other functional teams to align the organization on a coherent operating model and clear ownership.
Establish the planning, forecasting, and performance mechanisms needed to run the program and measure its success.
Design and launch pilots to validate our strategy, including clear learning plans, and create the stage gates that govern how and when the program scales.
Prepare and drive executive-ready reviews, business cases, and PR/FAQ and narrative documents, representing complex decisions and tradeoffs clearly to VPs and, when needed, SVPs.
Identify and mitigate program risks, building in the redundancy and contingency needed to protect continuity of service to stores and customers.
Actively develop the program management community through mentoring, promotion assessments, and best-practice sharing.
Travel Requirements: Approximately 30% travel to facilities, stores, and partner sites may be required.

About The Team

Our team is at the heart of transforming how customers experience fresh, prepared food at Whole Foods Market and Worldwide Grocery Stores. We set the category strategy and define production models that shape what lands on shelves and in shopping baskets across hundreds of stores nationwide. We work at the intersection of food, data, operations, and retail, partnering closely with supply chain, private brands, operations, e-commerce, finance, and technology to bring innovative, high-quality food programs to life. Our culture rewards curiosity, deep ownership, and creative problem-solving. If you are energized by building something new that directly shapes what customers eat every day, this is the team for you.

Basic Qualifications

7+ years of program or project management experience
7+ years of managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership experience
Bachelor's degree
Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
Experience owning program strategy and end to end delivery
Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
Experience in food production
Deep knowledge of food production and kitchen operations, supply chain and distribution, and the associated food safety and regulatory controls.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience delivering projects within scope, time, budget and quality
MBA
Experience working in a physical store
Experience designing or scaling fresh food production and distribution networks.
Working knowledge of food safety systems (HACCP), allergen and labeling requirements, and quality assurance at scale.

new_jobs.description:
