Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Location:
This role leads a global team and can be based in any major hub in AMER or EMEA.

Summary

Salesforce is seeking a dynamic and transformational Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) to lead the global Process Transformation (Regrello & Apromore) sales organization and serve as a key member of the AI Labs Leadership Team. This executive will own the growth strategy and commercial execution for the Process Transformation business, driving revenue growth, new customer acquisition, expansion, and scalable go-to-market motions globally. The CRO will play a critical role in shaping the future of the business, bringing together AI, data, and automation to redefine how customers optimize and transform their business processes.

The CRO will serve as a trusted advisor and strategic partner to senior leadership, helping define the business’s long-term growth strategy and strengthen Salesforce’s position for sustained market leadership. Success will require an unwavering customer focus, deep understanding of market dynamics, and the ability to translate strategy into disciplined execution across a complex, rapidly evolving organization.

The ideal candidate will bring enterprise-scale leadership, deep technical expertise in business process optimization, consultative nature, systematic builder, intellectual curiosity, commercial acumen, and exceptional organizational agility — with the ability to anticipate market shifts, align senior stakeholders, build and inspire high-performing teams, and accelerate growth in the era of the Agentic Enterprise.

Responsibilities

Own the revenue strategy for Process Transformation, driving durable, predictable growth across customer acquisition, expansion, retention, and disciplined execution.
Shape and execute the go-to-market strategy, leveraging targeted industry plays, optimized account coverage, strategic partnerships, and differentiated market motions to accelerate growth and customer adoption.
Lead the evolution of the sales motion in the era of the agentic enterprise, helping customers harness AI, data, and automation to transform business processes, customer engagement, and growth.
Serve as a trusted advisor to CEOs, CIOs, CTOs, Chief Data Officers, and other senior business leaders, positioning Salesforce’s Business Process Optimization portfolio as a strategic platform for enterprise transformation and measurable business outcomes.
Drive cross-functional alignment across Solution Engineering, Customer Success, Alliances & Channels, Industry GTM, and Enablement to deliver a unified, outcome-oriented customer experience and maximize revenue opportunities.
Own business performance and operating rigor, including forecasting, pipeline health, inspection, and performance management, providing clear, actionable insights to executive leadership.
Build and lead a high-performing organization, fostering a culture of accountability, customer obsession, and excellence while developing and retaining world-class talent.
Lead through organizational and market transformation, translating evolving business strategy into clear priorities, strong alignment, and decisive execution across the organization.
Serve as a strategic advisor to the Global CRO of AI Labs and the broader AI Labs Leadership Team, helping shape go-to-market priorities, investment decisions, organizational strategy, and critical initiatives that accelerate growth and scale the business.

Required Skills & Experience

15+ years of enterprise sales leadership experience, ideally with deep expertise in AI transformation, process mining and optimization, agentic SaaS, and/or emerging technology, with a proven track record of leading large-scale, global revenue organizations. 3rd- or 4th-line leadership experience required.
Proven ability to lead complex business transformation at scale, including cultural change, operating model evolution, organizational design, and capability building.
Strong general management, strategic planning, and operational leadership capabilities, with a disciplined, metrics-driven approach to execution and business performance.
Demonstrated ability to build trusted, long-term relationships with customers and C-level executives, translating those relationships into strategic partnerships and loyal, referenceable customers.
Exceptional cross-functional leadership in complex, matrixed organizations, with the ability to create alignment and drive outcomes across product, marketing, customer success, and regional field organizations without direct authority.
Executive presence and commercial acumen, with the credibility and influence to engage customers, partners, and internal stakeholders at the highest levels.
Outstanding executive communication skills, with the ability to articulate a compelling vision, simplify complexity, and inspire action across customers, field teams, and senior leadership forums.
Proven track record of recruiting, developing, and retaining exceptional sales leaders and go-to-market talent in highly competitive markets.
Relentless curiosity, agility, and adaptability, with the ability to prioritize effectively, navigate ambiguity, anticipate market shifts, and drive impact in a fast-moving environment.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

new_jobs.title: Director Product Management, Firefly Foundry
new_jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Adobe is building Firefly Foundry, the platform for customizing any media model at any depth. It spans image, video, audio, and multi-modal models, Adobe’s own and third-party alike, so all of it happens in one place. From keeping a marketing team on-brand without touching a model, to training a model that generates a studio’s characters at production quality, Firefly Foundry lets enterprises work at whatever depth the problem calls for.

We are seeking a Director of Product Management to help lead the Firefly Foundry product organization. You will drive product strategy and roadmap for key areas of the platform and partner closely with engineering, AI research, design, forward-deployed teams, product marketing, and go-to-market.

This is a rare opportunity to help shape a net-new, AI-first enterprise platform at global scale — defining how the world’s brands, studios, and developers customize, govern, and deploy generative media models, and how Firefly Foundry becomes an essential surface for enterprise AI media.

What you’ll do

Drive product strategy and roadmap for core areas of Firefly Foundry, spanning the platform’s levels of customization — from shared brand context and prompt intelligence to self-serve model tuning and managed franchise-model training.
Identify high-impact opportunities, prioritize features, define success metrics, and own end-to-end delivery across a multi-model, multi-modal platform.
Build a platform that lets customers start at any level of customization and go deeper as the work changes, so nothing they build at one level gets stranded when they move to the next.
Translate complex model-customization capabilities — fine-tuning, evals, version history, prompt intelligence, and IP guardrails — into clear, self-serve product experiences for enterprise teams.
Partner closely with engineering, AI research, design, and forward-deployed creative technologists, engineers, and research scientists to cut the time from an idea to a model running in production.
Shape how Firefly Foundry is consumed: direct API access for customers’ own applications, pipelines, and agents, and native experiences inside Firefly Studio and the Creative Cloud apps teams already use.
Own the trust layer as a first-class product surface — safety classifiers, jailbreak and prompt-injection defenses, copyright indemnity, data isolation, and the compliance and certifications customers inherit.
Contribute to Foundry’s model-agnostic strategy and token economics, keeping the best available base model one contract-free switch away for every customer.
Share product vision inside and outside Adobe, gathering feedback from enterprise customers, partners, and internal teams to guide direction.
Mentor and support product managers on the team, setting a high bar for product craft, ownership, and execution.

What you’ll need to succeed

8 or more years of product management experience, including leading complex, multi-surface or platform products.
A strong understanding of generative media models (image, video, audio, and multi-modal) and model customization — fine-tuning, evaluation, and prompt engineering.
Experience building enterprise or developer platforms — APIs, SDKs, or infrastructure products serving both technical and business users.
Experience leading product in a matrixed organization and influencing across engineering, research, design, services, and go-to-market teams.
Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous, zero-to-one ideas and turn them into shipped, scaled products.
Strong product judgment and systems thinking, with comfort working at the intersection of ML, infrastructure, governance, and UX.
A builder’s mindset, comfortable with ambiguity, fast iteration, and learning through shipping.
Strong communication skills and the ability to align senior leaders and cross-functional partners around a clear product narrative.
Familiarity with enterprise trust concerns — IP protection, safety guardrails, compliance, and data governance — is a strong plus.
Experience with a services-plus-product or forward-deployed engagement model, or with generative AI platforms, is a strong plus.
Bachelor’s degree required. Advanced degree or equivalent experience preferred.

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.

We are seeking a Principal Product Manager to lead product strategy and execution for OCI Developer Tool Products focused on how OCI customers and internal engineering teams use modern cloud-native and AI-native tools to develop, release, and operate software more effectively.

A central part of this role will be helping development teams transition to AI-native software development practices. You will identify where AI can meaningfully reduce friction, improve productivity, raise code quality, accelerate onboarding, and help developers better understand complex systems. You will work closely with engineering, UX, platform teams, security, compliance, and customers to define product direction, prioritize high-impact investments, and deliver tools that make development more intuitive, efficient, and intelligent.

Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

AWS Supply Chain Management (SCM) is building next-generation enterprise supply chain products from the ground up. Come be part of the team enabling Amazon AWS to rapidly grow and continue as the pioneer and widely recognized leader in Cloud Computing — and have immediate impact on thousands of developers and businesses around the world. We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for our Fulfillment Planning systems — the operational planning engine that decides what to manufacture, when to build it, and where to land it across our global infrastructure.

Why this role matters: AWS is massively scaling its infrastructure to meet unprecedented demand. We are redefining how we plan and execute fulfillment — driving hands-off-the-wheel automation and optimization to replace the manually intensive, computationally complex, and error-prone processes of today. You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The right candidate will possess deep supply chain or manufacturing planning domain expertise, a strong product management background, and demonstrated ability to influence engineering, science, and operations teams across organizational boundaries. You will define product requirements informed by optimization science, translate complex multi-stakeholder tradeoffs into clear product decisions, and drive adoption with planning teams accustomed to manual workflows. You must thrive in ambiguity, make high-judgment calls balancing business needs versus technical constraints, and lead through influence. As a Principal PM-T, you will set the long-term product vision, anticipate bottlenecks across planning horizons, and ensure that our fulfillment planning systems can support AWS's most ambitious growth targets.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Bachelor's degree
7+ years of technical product or program management experience
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements
Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
3+ years of supply chain management, production planning, capacity planning or manufacturing operations experience
Familiarity with operations research concepts such as linear programming, constraint optimization, or multi-objective optimization and the ability to translate scientific model outputs into product requirements and user experiences.

Description

At Amazon, data is critical to everything we do, from understanding product inventories across our global fulfillment centers to predicting what products to recommend to customers. Data ceaselessly informs our flywheel, helping us to understand customer needs, onboard new sellers and selection, and identify opportunities for cost savings. Business Data Technologies (BDT) provides trustworthy, intuitive, and cost-efficient solutions for Amazonians to secure, store, analyze, and transform this data at unparalleled scale. BDT owns, develops, and operates Andes, one of the largest data lakes in the world, storing 3+ exabytes of data, read/written to by 100k+ data pipelines, with >60k monthly active users. To do this, we need extraordinary individuals to build the next generation of data analytics, machine learning, and AI solutions for thousands of scientists, engineers, and analysts who rely upon us to get their jobs done.

The BDT-AI4ME organization works bring AI-centric methodologies and automations to Amazon organizations needing to connect their business teams and objectives with their data teams and architectures. The BDT-AI4ME organization seeks to lower the cognitive load needed to connect business to data through best of class agents and AI-ready metadata to allow anyone to access data to gain insights.

BDT Principal Product Managers - Tech (PMT) provide the three-year product visions and strategies for their ~50 person organizations, while also providing clear, iterative roadmaps to get there. They deliver results in collaboration with Engineering teams and Principal Engineers to create clean architectures that support coherent and intuitive user experiences. As a Principal Product Manager in the BDT-AI4ME organization, you understand ways that enterprises apply AI to solve business and technical problems. You understand the ways that Amazon’s business teams work with their data teams, and you seek to reduce friction and error-proneness of those interactions by enhancing business processes and automations using AI.

You focus on the data needs of business users and their user journeys from question to insight. You formulate a strategy for transforming the ways Amazon extracts value from its data through iterative improvements involving AI enablement, process optimization, role guidelines, and org design.

You understand and work to improve the interfaces (MCPs, APIs) that technology teams of Amazon’s business orgs use to connect their bespoke AI solutions to the Andes data lake.

Launching a capability is only the start. Post launch, you are responsible for increasing usage, iterating on user feedback, and user education. You partner with engineering, human resources, legal, documentation, solution architecture, privacy, finance, and more to optimize usage of the Andes data lake for AI-based methodologies.

Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for new customer acquisition and traffic for Amazon Business India

Design and ship an agentic AI-led conversational registration experience that reduces friction and improves conversion

Description

Amazon's Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) organization is seeking a Senior Product Manager - Technical to own the product strategy and roadmap for OmniFrost, Amazon's next-generation SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) platform. OmniFrost is a mobile-first, AI-powered monitoring and control system designed to replace both legacy vendor SCADA and Amazon's existing SCADA 2.0 across the global

fulfilment network.

This role owns the end-to-end product lifecycle for OmniFrost from defining requirements and success metrics through scaled network deployment. You will work directly with RME field teams,engineering, and leadership to drive a production-ready platform that delivers measurable operational impact at scale.

Key job responsibilities

Define and own the OmniFrost product vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap covering pilot validation through network-wide deployment across technically feasible sites globally
Establish measurable KPIs tied to business outcomes: MTTR improvement, system availability, user adoption, alarm latency, and technician satisfaction (NPS)
Define deployment requirements across CF, AMZL, and ATS business types spanning NA and EU regions, covering diverse SCADA configurations and equipment vendors (Vanderlande, Dematic, Amazon ARS)
Drive feature prioritization across core capabilities: interactive 2D/3D layouts, AI-assisted triage (Graph RAG-based smart recommendations), live camera feeds, command and control, native APM integration, and multi-device access
Design experimental methodology including matched-pair control sites and measurement frameworks to prove OmniFrost delivers incremental value beyond existing solutions
Own Go/No-Go criteria for scale deployment based on validated pilot results
Partner with Spectralink/DeFrost team on deployment automation economics targeting significant reduction in retrofit time and cost
Coordinate with Quattro, COSMOS, BiFrost, APM, and OEE engineering teams on technical dependencies and integration requirements
Represent RME customer needs in architectural decisions for AI-assisted triage, agentic AI (MCP protocol), alarm consolidation, and mobile-first design
Manage stakeholder alignment across RME field leadership, GES, ELM, Controls Engineering, and executive steering committees

About The Team

The Controls Engineering (CE) team within Central RME builds and deploys Amazon's internal SCADA platform across the global fulfilment network. We provide real-time equipment monitoring and control capabilities to RME technicians across sites in North America, Europe, LATAM, and Asia-Pacific.

Our mission is to eliminate dependency on third-party vendor SCADA systems, reduce equipment downtime through proactive monitoring (proven 44% MTTR reduction), and deliver unified visibility across all equipment vendors. Description

NAS Selection is seeking a Senior Product Manager to build Selection of the Future — evolving how Amazon identifies, prioritizes, and closes selection gaps to ensure we focus on what matters most to customers. Our current selection strategy has driven meaningful coverage improvements — we track 85K+ important brands, 10M+ head selection items, and have identified $34.6B in selection gap opportunity. We are building capabilities to quantify gap value, prioritize must-have selection over marginal variants, and predict which emerging brands will drive lasting customer impact. Key job responsibilities

Key job responsibilities

This includes sizing the revenue opportunity of selection gaps at both item and brand level, identifying emerging brands gaining traction on social platforms before they appear in traditional Amazon signals, and establishing criteria for "unregretted gaps" — high-effort, low-value opportunities like undifferentiated pack sizes and low-demand variants that don't warrant investment.

This includes accelerating brand gap identification, item-level defect diagnosis, and seller engagement opportunities. Integrate substitutability and purchase intent models to sharpen prioritization and surface insights that enable business teams to focus on gaps that matter most to customers — while automating resolution of non-strategic gaps.

new_jobs.description:
Description

AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Do you want to define the scientific direction for how a global contact-center network forecasts demand, schedules its workforce, and optimizes operations in real time? The Eliza team within Amazon Connect (FCS) is looking for a Principal Research Scientist with a deep operations research specialization to set the research agenda in operations science — combinatorial optimization, queueing theory, stochastic modeling, and forecasting — and to translate that research into production systems that serve millions of customer interactions.

As a Principal Research Scientist you will be the senior technical voice for operations research across the org. You will identify the highest-leverage scientific problems, architect novel solutions, and drive them from research through production deployment. You will not sit apart from the work - you will remain deeply hands-on with data, models, and systems while raising the scientific bar for scientists and engineers around you. This is an individual-contributor Principal role: your influence comes from technical depth, invention, and the ability to move business and engineering roadmaps through scientific rigor.

You will operate at the intersection of demand forecasting, workforce scheduling, and network optimization - applying combinatorial optimization to large-scale scheduling and resource-allocation problems and queueing theory to model contact-center dynamics under uncertainty, non-stationarity, and competing operational constraints at Internet scale - turning that reasoning into systems that continuously sense, predict, and optimize.

Key job responsibilities

Set the multi-year research direction for operations research across contact-center demand prediction, workforce scheduling, and network optimization.
Design and deliver novel algorithms in combinatorial optimization (large-scale scheduling, resource allocation, integer/constraint programming) and queueing theory (contact-center modeling, staffing under stochastic arrivals), alongside stochastic modeling and time-series forecasting, that advance the state of the art while solving real operational problems.
Own end-to-end scientific solutions — from problem formulation and prototyping to production deployment — ensuring robustness, explainability, and seamless integration with existing systems.
Design rigorous experiments and evaluation methodology to validate hypotheses and quantify business impact; establish scientific-excellence mechanisms (metrics, benchmarks, peer review) that the broader science team adopts.
Partner with engineering, product, and operations teams to define data and logging requirements, get them prioritized on roadmaps, and translate scientific capabilities into measurable business outcomes.
Influence senior leadership through written papers and deep-dives, framing complex algorithmic trade-offs in clear business terms.
Mentor and raise the bar for applied and research scientists across the org while maintaining significant hands-on technical contribution.
Represent the team's science externally where appropriate (publications, patents, top-tier venues such as INFORMS, NeurIPS, ICML).

A day in the life

Your day blends hands-on science with technical leadership. You might spend the morning deep in data and models — prototyping a new combinatorial-optimization formulation for workforce scheduling or a queueing model for staffing under stochastic arrivals against production infrastructure — and the afternoon guiding fellow scientists through a hard optimization or stochastic-modeling problem, reviewing an experiment design, or aligning engineering partners on the data architecture needed to unlock the next capability. You'll drive technical discussions with the team and key stakeholders and periodically write and present papers that shape the business and engineering roadmap.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

new_jobs.title: Principal Product Manager Technical (PMT-ES), Amazon S3
new_jobs.description:
Description

Come build the future of high performance storage with Amazon S3 Express, the storage class purpose built to co-locate storage with compute and deliver consistent single digit millisecond data access. Launched at re:Invent 2023, it is designed for the most demanding, performance sensitive workloads, and we are still in the earliest innings. As AI training, inference, and agentic workloads reshape what applications demand from storage, this is where the hardest problems get solved.

As a Principal PMT, you will own product strategy for a service operating at the frontier of performance. The AI space is moving fast, the requirements are ambiguous, and the technical challenges are hard. Defining what the product becomes, from first principles, is the core of this role. You will drive an agentic storage strategy that confronts the inference memory wall and the explosion of context windows, shifting workloads away from compute heavy architectures and toward layered caching fabrics. You will shape a portfolio of storage products built for AI model training and inference, anchoring general purpose solutions around ultra low latency and POSIX compliant workloads while extending the high bandwidth object storage that S3 Express delivers. You will also focus on accelerator utilization across GPU, Trainium, and Inferentia deployments, provisioning high performance zonal storage with the goal of a full accelerator attach rate.

You will spend your time in product definition, navigating ambiguity, solving deep technical problems, and building the storage foundation that future workloads will depend on. You will thrive here if you love technology, can reason about complex distributed systems, and enjoy working shoulder to shoulder with engineering teams. You bring a strong ownership bias, a persistent drive to make things better, and you are comfortable facilitating executive reviews, diving deep into data, and expressing ideas clearly through writing.

A defining part of this role is who you work with. You will partner with industry leaders across the AI space and teams throughout AWS to solve horizontal high performance computing problems.

(Principal PMT / Principal PMT-ES)

In this role you will

Develop crisp business requirements and user stories through direct contact with customers and partners at the leading edge of AI and high performance computing
Define product strategy and roadmap, translating ambiguous, fast moving requirements into a clear path forward
Solve the storage challenges of AI training and inference, from the inference memory wall to accelerator utilization, by shaping layered caching and high performance zonal storage
Collaborate with product managers, software development managers, and engineers to define, build, and roll out features
Bring services and features to market, including beta programs, product marketing, and industry analyst engagement
Present solutions and the roadmap to customers at conferences and executive briefings
Partner with industry leaders in AI and teams across AWS to solve horizontal high performance computing challenges, and with the leadership team to set strategy for S3 Express One Zone

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

We are building the Experimentation & Economic Value Platform to change that: a centralized system that connects experimentation across pricing, marketing, and merchandising into causal science and forecasting models, so every investment decision is backed by evidence rather than assumption.

We are seeking a Principal Product Manager-Tech to own this product end-to-end. You will define the conceptual architecture for a suite of interconnected services—experimentation engines spanning pricing, marketing, and economic value measurement, along with a parameter store, experiment registry, and coordination layer—and partner closely with engineering to build them. A critical part of the role is connecting science outcomes to production systems: ensuring that experiment results, model parameters, and causal estimates flow reliably into the downstream decision products that consume them. You will own the product and experimentation roadmap, define success metrics on usage, engagement, and efficiency, build a streamlined intake process, and drive integration with downstream science and business-facing products. This is a high-visibility, high-autonomy role where you will shape how Amazon's largest consumer hardware business makes data-driven decisions.

Key job responsibilities

Define the Conceptual Architecture

Define and deliver the conceptual architecture for the platform's experimentation engines (pricing, marketing, and economic value measurement), parameter store, experiment registry, coordination layer, and results store
Define integration points with downstream science models (e.g., incrementality modeling, demand forecasting) and business-facing products (e.g., spend optimization, scenario planning, and emerging optimization products)
Partner closely with engineering leadership to translate the conceptual architecture into technical designs, and sequence the development roadmap

Own the Product Vision, Roadmap & Prioritization

Define and drive the product vision, tenets, and multi-year roadmap for the Experimentation & Economic Value Platform
Own the experimentation intake process, roadmap, and prioritization across pricing, marketing, and economic value workstreams; prioritize science and engineering bandwidth in partnership with DSO Product and Engineering managers
Define, prioritize, and track product success metrics: platform adoption, usage, engagement, experiment velocity, model calibration improvement, and iROAS gains

Build a Scalable, AI-Augmented Experimentation Product

Define how AI agents and automated workflows accelerate experimentation design, execution, monitoring, and insights across the full experimentation lifecycle
Own and deliver experimentation platforms for joint marketing and pricing experiments
Implement monitoring systems in partnership with data science and software development—covering data quality, statistical significance, and optimization recommendations—across marketing experimentation and economic value refresh processes

Drive Rigorous Experiment Design & Execution

Translate user stories and business questions into statistically rigorous randomized controlled trials (RCTs) at the geo and user level
Own experiment prioritization, design quality, and execution standards globally—ensuring consistency across macro experiments (geo-level strategic allocation questions) and micro experiments (platform-native A/B tests optimizing creative, audience, and bid strategies)
Partner with economists and data scientists to define RCT validity criteria, create reusable design templates, develop power calculation guidelines, and establish quality bars to ensure direct usability by the business

Lead Stakeholder Engagement & Operational Excellence

Establish regular business reviews with senior leadership (VP+) to communicate platform progress, experiment impact, and investment priorities
Build a streamlined, trackable intake process that replaces ad-hoc coordination with structured experiment requests, transparent prioritization, and automated scheduling

new_jobs.description:
Description

AI is transforming every corner of Amazon — and with that transformation comes the responsibility to get it right. The Amazon Responsible AI (RAI) team is building the systems and programs that ensure Amazon's AI is fair, safe, transparent, and compliant with emerging global regulations. We are looking for a Sr. Product Manager - Technical who wants to define the product vision for AI governance at Amazon scale — building the tools and experiences that help thousands of builder teams develop AI responsibly without slowing down.

No one has solved AI governance at this scale before. Today, tracking thousands of AI systems against evolving regulatory frameworks, internal expectations, and voluntary commitments is a problem that's impossible to manage manually. You'll define the product that makes it possible — automating what would take an army of auditors, and giving builders the tools to do the right thing without slowing down. This is a greenfield opportunity on a small, senior team building from scratch alongside Amazon Scholars, Principal Applied Scientists, and policy experts. You'll own the product vision and shape the platform direction.

As a PMT on the Responsible AI team, you will define and drive the product strategy for our AI governance platform, working at the intersection of technology, policy, and science. You'll partner deeply with engineering teams building the platform, Applied Scientists developing AI-powered classification and assessment models, and policy experts interpreting regulatory requirements — turning ambiguity into a clear, prioritized roadmap that delivers customer value.

This role is for product leaders who thrive in ambiguity, are energized by the challenge of defining new product categories, and are motivated by the societal impact of ensuring AI systems are developed responsibly.

Key job responsibilities

Define the product vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for Amazon's AI governance platform — the system that provides portfolio-level visibility into AI compliance posture across the company
Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for responsible AI tooling: from discovery and customer research through requirements definition, development, launch, and adoption at scale
Translate complex regulatory requirements (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, emerging state/federal AI legislation) and internal responsible AI expectations into builder-friendly product experiences and self-service workflows
Drive product strategy for AI system discovery, risk classification, and compliance evidence collection — working backward from builder needs to reduce friction while meeting governance obligations
Define metrics and KPIs that measure responsible AI adoption, tool effectiveness, and compliance coverage — using data to prioritize roadmap investments and communicate progress to leadership
Partner with Applied Scientists to shape AI-powered features (automated risk classification, compliance gap detection, evidence generation) and define how ML models integrate into the product experience
Conduct customer research with internal builder teams across Amazon to deeply understand pain points, workflows, and compliance challenges — and turn those insights into prioritized product requirements
Work cross-functionally with Privacy, Legal, Security, and RAI Science to ensure product decisions align with regulatory obligations, customer trust requirements, and scientific best practices
Influence engineering architecture decisions by evaluating technical trade-offs, understanding system constraints, and ensuring the platform can scale to support Amazon's AI portfolio
Develop and present product strategy, roadmaps, and business cases to VP+ leadership — clearly articulating the value proposition and investment rationale for responsible AI tooling

About The Team

Amazon Responsible AI works to maximize the benefits and minimize the risks of AI technology across Amazon. We define responsible AI through core dimensions — Fairness, Safety, Privacy, Security, Veracity, Robustness, Explainability, Transparency, Controllability, and Governance — and we build the tools and programs that help Amazon's builder teams deliver on those dimensions at scale. Our team includes Applied Scientists, Amazon Scholars, Security Engineers, TPMs, SDEs, and policy specialists. We are science-led, independent advisors who prioritize enablement over enforcement — providing expert guidance and practical solutions that make responsible AI easy to implement. We are building the next generation of AI governance infrastructure from the ground up.

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Designing and training relevance models, including LLM fine-tuning and learning-to-rank (LTR) approaches
Building robust evaluation pipelines using offline metrics and online A/B experimentation
Driving cross-org collaboration with platform partners, other applied science teams, and product teams across time zones
Setting vision and directions for agentic search in CoPilot Chat inspired by state-of-the-art and data-driven analysis

This role requires a mix of technical depth, strategic execution, and people management to shape the next generation of AI-powered search experiences.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. new_jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Alexa Automotive, Scaling Initiatives, Amazon Smart Vehicles
new_jobs.description:
Description

The Amazon Alexa Automotive team is looking for a product leader to help drive our Alexa Custom Assistant (ACA) product — our Auto OEM-centric product offering a custom branded version of our LLM-powered Alexa experience. We’re looking for a PM to lead the definition and delivery of our LLM-powered products and automation enablers, allowing for us to scale our ACA offering across multiple global OEMs.

Our ideal candidate will have launched multiple, impactful products, and have deep understanding of product management, user experience, partner integration and development tooling, system design and software development, and partner management. You should be analytical, able to work and influence cross-functionally across multiple business units, and thrive in entrepreneurial, fast-paced environments.

Experience in automotive infotainment, voice, partner integration tooling, and/or billing systems is a plus but not a must-have (we welcome product managers from diverse backgrounds to our team as they bring fresh perspectives to our products). AI fluency is highly encouraged.

Key job responsibilities

Key job responsibilities

Operate as PM lead on the projects where we work to help our OEM partners accelerate their time to market for our ACA product through LLM-enabled tooling and automations (docs, support tickets, test externalization, billing, etc.)
Auto PM lead for our suite of Agent creation and integration tooling in partnership with AWS
Own a suite of our automotive custom / personalized voice enabler products
Define and drive delivery targets and operational excellence for your products
---
Lead product strategy and delivery in a customer and partner obsessed manner.
Define creative, high quality product requirements and roadmaps based on product strategy.
Manage prioritization and trade-offs among customer experience, performance & operational support requirements.
Create buy-in for product vision across internal partner teams as well as external OEM partners (incl senior leaders)
Work closely with science / engineering teams to deliver products to market using agile development methodologies.
Identify and resolve issues that may impair the team’s ability to meet strategic, financial, and technical goals

A day in the life

You will drive requirements and execution of features and experiences for our Automotive ScaleX product and enablers, with a focus on scaling our ACA product. You will own product vision, synthesize customer and business requirements into product roadmaps, and launch new features from start to finish. You will be a champion of this product both internally to senior leadership as well as externally to the industry. You will work in close collaboration with internal stakeholders and external strategic OEM partners, operating as product owner for these major strategic launches. You’ll sell-in your vision, collaborate on requirements, prioritize delivery, make strategic recommendations, and hold everybody to a high standard of excellence. A successful candidate will have a passion for designing delightful customer experiences, strong partner skills, and the entrepreneurial grit to get things done!

About The Team

Our team’s mission is to provide delightful, LLM-powered assistant experiences to our automotive customers. Our automotive products lead the way in delivering next generation in-vehicle digital experiences with the goal of reducing friction in our customers' lives, and helping to delight and simplify along the way. We look for people who will push us to get better, and are constructive in finding solutions to tough problems.

This is a highly cross-functional product leadership role with the opportunity to influence across multiple organizations within Alexa and Devices & Services business.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
Experience managing technical products or online services
Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools
Experience in B2B, high-tech products/services preferred
Experience with strong project management skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
5+ years of end to end product delivery experience
Experience completing complex tasks quickly with little to no guidance and react with appropriate urgency to situations that require a quick turnaround, or experience in senior level leadership support

Description

Advertising is a strategic bet for Amazon and is one of the fastest growing business units within Amazon India. Sponsored Ads is our flagship performance ads product and the backbone of our Advertising business. We are strengthening our offering by continuously building and enhancing product capability to improve shopper engagement and advertiser experience.

We are looking for a Sr. Product Manager (Tech) to own monetization charter and grow Ads business in India and Emerging Markets.

You will manage the complete business of your product area including establishing key metrics, setting and meeting goals on business/product metrics, advertiser engagement, and retention. Manage all aspects of project including organizing and planning, estimating, managing resources, tracking, risk & opportunity, quality, documentation and change management.

Engage frequently with stakeholders (WW, India and Emerging markets) to identify collaboration opportunities

You will engage with other key teams in India Ads like Demand, Marketing, Sales and Account Management teams. Beyond these, you will have ample opportunities to interact and influence WW Product, Tech, Applied Science teams etc.

Experience with end to end product delivery
